main_findings.description: The signs assigned to points for all 3 components in Fig. 4 were reversed: for example, + 2 should be − 2, and vice versa.

condition_or_topic: Correction to the calculation of Sagittal age-adjusted score (SAAS) for adult spinal deformity (ASD)

document_sections.heading: Author Correction: Sagittal age‑adjusted score (SAAS) for adult spinal deformity (ASD) more effectively predicts surgical outcomes and proximal junctional kyphosis than previous classifications
document_sections.content: In Fig. 4 of the original article, the point signs for all 3 components were reversed. For example, + 2 should be − 2, and the reverse correction also applies. The corrected Fig. 4 is presented, and the original article has been updated.

document_sections.heading: Fig. 4
document_sections.content: The figure explains how Sagittal age-adjusted score (SAAS) is calculated from three sagittal components. It provides the formulas for determining age-adjusted alignment targets for each component.

main_conclusion: The point signs in Fig. 4 were reversed for all 3 components of the Sagittal age-adjusted score (SAAS): + 2 should be − 2, and vice versa. The original article has been corrected.
narrative_summary: This author correction concerns an article on the Sagittal age-adjusted score (SAAS) in adult spinal deformity (ASD). The article’s title describes SAAS as a predictor of surgical outcomes and proximal junctional kyphosis compared with previous classifications, but this correction does not report a new assessment of those outcomes. Instead, it addresses Fig. 4, which depicts the calculation of SAAS using three sagittal components and identifies formulas for the age-adjusted alignment targets of each component. The notice states that the signs for points associated with all 3 components were displayed incorrectly. A point shown as + 2 should be − 2, and the opposite reversal applies where the negative sign was shown. The original article has been amended to include the corrected figure. For clinical interpretation, the notice clarifies the direction of point assignments in the SAAS calculation figure; it does not change or independently evaluate the article’s claims about prediction of surgical outcomes or proximal junctional kyphosis.
